scheduler.$description: Scheduler: the bar, the day views (the head with the dates and the all-day panel, the time ruler and the cells) and the month view, the appointments, their tooltip and "+N more". The sizes, the layout values and the shares that mix an appointment's own colour into its fill, text and edges are plain tokens; every other piece is a unit (`$units`).

month-date-align.$description: Where a month cell's day number stands: start, center or end.

state-inset.$description: How far the load state stands from the corner, and its padding.

appointment-foreground.$description: The text an appointment's colour is mixed into (`appointment-text-mix`).

appointment-text-mix.$description: How much of the appointment's colour its text takes (0: the text colour alone).

appointment-frame-color.$description: A box's four edges: each one's width and how much of the appointment's colour it takes (0: this neutral frame colour; 100: the colour).

appointment-open-tint.$description: An open appointment (its tooltip showing): how much of its colour is laid over the box's fill (0: unchanged; 100: the colour).

appointment-open-color.$description: The text of an open appointment, laid over its text and time by `appointment-open-color-mix` (0: unchanged).

appointment-open-edge-color.$description: The edges of an open appointment, laid over each edge's colour by `appointment-open-edge-mix` (0: unchanged).

appointment-top-width.$description: The top edge of a box, and how much of the appointment's colour it takes (a stripe on top).

appointment-start-mix.$description: How much of the appointment's colour the start stripe takes.

appointment-continued-start-width.$description: The start edge of a bar that goes on from before what is shown.

chip-background.$description: A month view's chip (a timed appointment in a day): its fill and four edges, as a box's.

chip-color.$description: A chip's text: this colour, taking `chip-text-mix` of the appointment's (0: this colour alone).

tooltip-frame-color.$description: The tooltip of an appointment: its four edges, as a box's.

more-item-frame-color.$description: An item of "+N more":       its four edges, as a box's.

today-button.$description: Today, in the bar (its size is the bar's).

step-button.$description: Previous and next, in the bar.

title-button.$description: The range in the bar, opening the calendar: its variant and type.

view-button.$description: A view in the bar (pressed: the current one).

tooltip-button.$description: Edit and Delete in the tooltip.

tooltip-popup.$description: The tooltip's popup: its padding adds to the tooltip's own.

scheduler.$description: The whole scheduler: its frame, corners, fill and text.

bar.$description: The bar over the views (the kit's toolbar): Today, the steps, the title, the views; a line under it.

head.$description: The day views' head: the dates and the all-day panel; a line under it.

date.$description: A day's head in a day view: its weekday and its number.

day-number.$description: A day's number, in a day head or a month cell (`month`); `today`, `outside` the month. Its size: `date-number-size`, `month-date-size`.

all-day.$description: The all-day panel; a line over it.

hour.$description: An hour on the time ruler.

time-row.$description: A row of time cells: the line over it (`hour`: the row an hour starts).

cell.$description: A cell: a time slot, an all-day cell or a month day (`month`); today's column, off hours, a holiday, outside the month, a weekend, the first day of a week row; a past day (`past`: a layer over its fill); under the pointer, selected, focused by the keys.

now.$description: The line at the time it is now, over its day.

now-dot.$description: A dot at the start of the now line.

weekdays.$description: The month view's head: the weekdays; a line under it.

weekday-name.$description: A weekday in the month view's head.

week-row.$description: A week in the month view: the line over it (`first`: none over the first week).

appointment.$description: An appointment's box (`timed` in a day, a `bar` over the all-day panel or a month week, a `chip` in a month cell): its space, text size, corners (a piece that goes on before or after: `timed-before`, `bar-after` …), focused by the keys, disabled, one that can be dragged, the box being moved (`draft`), one that cannot go where it stands (`invalid`), one being saved. Its fill, text and four edges mix its own colour by the plain `appointment-*`, `chip-*` shares.

appointment-content.$description: An appointment's text and time (`row`: side by side, in a bar, a chip or a short one).

appointment-time.$description: An appointment's time (`open`: while its tooltip shows).

dot.$description: A dot before a chip's text, in the appointment's colour.

tooltip.$description: An appointment's tooltip: its space and width (its edges mix the appointment's colour by the plain `tooltip-*` shares).

swatch.$description: A swatch in the appointment's colour before the title, on its first line.

more-item.$description: An appointment in the list (`hover`, `focus`; its edges mix its colour by the plain `more-item-*` shares).

state.$description: What the scheduler says while it loads or failed (`danger`).
